annotations.title: Check an app built with AI tools

description: Reads the public pages and public JavaScript of a web app (typically built with Lovable, Bolt, v0, Replit or similar) and reports exposed API keys, public source maps, missing security headers, stale deploys, missing error monitoring and AI model calls made from the browser. Passive check: it never logs in, submits forms or probes private routes.

language.description: Language of the report: 'pt' (Portuguese) or 'es' (Spanish). Use the user's language; default 'pt'.

sends_user_data_to_ai.description: Optional. Whether the user says the app sends its users' data to an AI model.

url.description: Public address of the site to check, e.g. 'example.com' or 'https://example.com'.

name: check_ai_built_app
title: Check an app built with AI tools
